author: Epic Games
description:
Leon Must Die Forever is available now as a free update to Resident Evil Requiem! https://epic.gm/re-requiem

Unlocked by completing the story, this additional minigame mode challenges you to clear numerous stages as Leon while unlocking exclusive enhancer abilities. The fast-paced action is distinct from the main story mode, and is packed with replay value. Can you make it to the end alive and defeat the boss within the time limit?  Multiple difficulty levels are available, including an extreme high-difficulty mode for only the most confident players. True to the title, you’ll "die forever"...
title: Resident Evil Requiem | Leon Must Die Forever
